question: Does J <=_h K imply Delta_J divides Delta_K, or does Gilmer's argument genuinely need the stronger J <= K?
verdict: BOTH. Gilmer's proof does need more (Friedl-Powell: 'Gilmer's proof does not extend to the topological category'), but the theorem is TRUE under strictly weaker hypotheses by a different proof. So J <=_h K implies Delta_J | Delta_K.

primary_source.title: Homotopy ribbon concordance and Alexander polynomials
primary_source.theorem_1_1: If J >=_top L then Delta_L divides Delta_J
primary_source.definition_of_geq_top: locally flat concordance C in S^3 x I from J to -L with pi_1(X_J) -> pi_1(X_C) SURJECTIVE and pi_1(X_L) -> pi_1(X_C) INJECTIVE
primary_source.decisive_remark_verbatim: Perhaps somewhat surprisingly, the condition that pi_1(X_L) -> pi_1(X_C) is injective is not needed anywhere in our proof of Theorem 1.1.
primary_source.gilmer_remark_verbatim: For knots and for >=_sm instead of >=_top, Theorem 1.1 is a consequence of a more general theorem of Gilmer. However Gilmer's proof does not extend to the topological category.

convention_alignment.warning: the two papers orient the relation oppositely; inverting this would invert the conclusion
convention_alignment.so_Delta_L_divides_Delta_J_reads: Delta_J | Delta_K in Agol-Ren's J <= K notation, the direction needed

chain_of_implication: Agol-Ren <=_h gives a relative handle decomposition of the concordance complement with only 1- and 2-handles, relative to the SMALLER end X_J (fixed by the ribbon-disk case: X_U a solid torus, disk exterior a 0-handle plus 1- and 2-handles)

dually that is a decomposition relative to X_K with handles of index 3 and 2 only, i.e. index >= 2, which can only add relations to pi_1, so pi_1(X_K) -> pi_1(X_C) is SURJECTIVE; Friedl-Powell make exactly this step for >=_sm in their section 1

a homotopy I x S^3 is a simply connected h-cobordism from S^3 to S^3, hence HOMEOMORPHIC to S^3 x I by Freedman's topological h-cobordism theorem, so a smooth concordance in it is a locally flat concordance in S^3 x I, the category Friedl-Powell work in
Theorem 1.1 needs only the surjectivity, by the authors' own remark, so no appeal to Gordon Lemma 3.1 or residual finiteness is required
therefore J <=_h K implies Delta_J | Delta_K
ambient_note: Friedl-Powell separately remark their proof 'can also be generalised to concordances between links in homology spheres' but did not carry it out; that remark is NOT relied on here. The Freedman h-cobordism route is used instead.

strengthening_not_relied_on.source: author comment in the Friedl-Powell LaTeX source
strengthening_not_relied_on.content: Gordon's argument actually proves: if Y = X with n 1-handles and n 2-handles attached and H_*(Y,X) = 0, then pi_1(X) -> pi_1(Y) is a monomorphism, whenever pi_1(X) is residually finite
strengthening_not_relied_on.why_it_applies_under_leq_h: handle counts are automatically balanced since chi(X_C) = chi(X_J) = 0 for homology circles, H_*(X_C,X_J) = 0, and knot groups are residually finite
strengthening_not_relied_on.consequence: <=_h implies the FULL >=_top condition, not merely the half Theorem 1.1 uses

campaign_consequence.minimality_lemma_now_available: a nontrivial compression strictly reduces -chi, so a proper <=_h-predecessor of a fibered knot has strictly smaller genus
campaign_consequence.genus_0_predecessor: EXCLUDED: U <=_h 6_3 would make 6_3 handle-ribbon hence slice, but det = 13 is not a perfect square
campaign_consequence.genus_1_predecessors: EXCLUDED: Delta(3_1) = t^2-t+1 and Delta(4_1) = t^2-3t+1 neither divides the irreducible Delta(6_3) = t^4-3t^3+5t^2-3t+1
campaign_consequence.conclusion: K_0 = 6_3 and K_1 = A_1(6_3) are both <=_h-minimal and distinct, so by Agol-Ren Corollary 1.10(1), if they are smoothly concordant then the Slice-Ribbon Conjecture is false
campaign_consequence.what_this_buys: the certificate now needs only fibered + distinct + <=_h-minimal, with no irreducible-Alexander hypothesis on the pair and no prime-summand audit, retiring the dependency that ERRATA_2026-09-16 E16-1 already had to correct once
campaign_consequence.what_is_unchanged: the missing ingredient is still a smooth concordance K_0 ~ K_1

positive_control.example: Friedl-Powell's own: 3_1 # -3_1 and 4_1 # -4_1 are both slice hence concordant
positive_control.meaning: coprime, so neither is homotopy ribbon concordant to the other: the divisibility test is not vacuous on concordant pairs

why_no_counterexample_hunt: Gilmer proves divisibility under <=. Any pair with J <=_h K and Delta_J not dividing Delta_K would satisfy J <=_h K but J not<= K, hence would by itself prove <=_h != <=, the question Agol-Ren record as open. A counterexample search was therefore at least as hard as an open problem; only the proof direction was tractable.
